title: SymbolRefContribution
description: A reference (use-site) to a symbol from another location. Lift of an SCIP occurrence with role=Reference. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `ScipJavaKS` and other per-language ScipKSs; `JoernKS`.

fromSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the source endpoint (must resolve to a Index.ScipSymbol (or other code-bearing slot) in this Bb).

toSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the target endpoint (must resolve to a Index.ScipSymbol (or other code-bearing slot) in this Bb).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the referencing site.
